takes.text: What if Earth spun faster, and couldn't stop?
Only about seventeen times faster, a day of an hour and twenty-four minutes, and you leave the ground behind.
That is the whole distance between standing and flying.
Only the spin changes, and it only gets faster.
Right now the ground carries you at about sixteen hundred and seventy kilometers an hour.
